name: Sessionize
description: Sessionize is a call-for-speakers and event-content platform for collecting submissions, evaluating proposals, managing speakers, building schedules and publishing session and speaker data to event sites and apps.
agentUseSummary: Connect one organizer-created Sessionize JSON endpoint through Railway's encrypted boundary, then let selected agents list bounded published sessions or inspect one exact session without custom or private data.

credentialRequirements.name: SESSIONIZE_ENDPOINT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Sessionize endpoint ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a JSON Sessions endpoint with only intended public fields, then enter its unique endpoint ID.

capabilities.label: Read published schedule
capabilities.description: Read bounded session metadata from one organizer-created, field-selected Sessionize endpoint.

allowed.label: List sessions
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five sessions from the configured endpoint.

allowed.label: Read a session
allowed.description: Read one exact session from the configured endpoint.

blocked.label: Block custom fields and files
blocked.description: Questions, answers, custom fields, files, links, biographies and unselected endpoint data are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block organizer account data
blocked.description: Submissions, evaluations, private speaker records, team settings and organizer account data are not accessible.

blocked.label: Block raw endpoint access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoint IDs, views, XML, automatic traversal and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded schedule reads run directly; custom fields, files, private account data and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; endpoint selection, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed schedule reads against one fixed Sessionize capability endpoint.
Relay mounts two typed schedule reads against one fixed Sessionize capability endpoint.

providerSetup.nextAction: The organizer creates a JSON Sessions endpoint, disables unnecessary custom fields, enters its endpoint ID in Relay and selects schedule-read capability plus Safe or Dangerous policy.

evidence.supports: Sessionize documents organizer-created event endpoints, read-only JSON/XML/iCalendar access, unique endpoint IDs, sessions/speakers/rooms, field selection, no authentication and confidentiality guidance for endpoint URLs.
Sessionize's official demo endpoint demonstrates the fixed /api/v2/{endpointId}/view/Sessions JSON shape with grouped sessions, IDs, titles, times, rooms and speakers.
